name: False Vigor, Mass
body:
School necromancy; Level death mage 8

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a drop of blood)

EFFECT

Range Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target One or more creatures, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart.
Duration 1 hour/level or until discharged, see text
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You harness the powers of unlife to grant the targets a limited ability to avoid death. While the spell is in effect, the targets gain temporary hit points equal to 3d10 +1 per caster level (maximum +25).
